name: Devil May Cry
description: In this epic battle of good vs. evil, the lines are blurry as hell. But a devilishly handsome demon hunter could be the world's best hope for salvation.

videos.title: Inferno
videos.overview: A violent heist at a Vatican City museum sparks chaos, pulling unsuspecting demon hunter Dante into a sinister plot to forge a rift between worlds.

videos.title: Our Lady of Sorrows
videos.overview: In Washington, DARKCOM gathers a group of mercenaries and offers a bounty to bring in Dante — and the family heirloom that hangs around his neck.

videos.title: The Deep and Savage Way
videos.overview: A flashback sheds light on Mary's past. In the present, a convoy with precious cargo hits a roadblock as the White Rabbit creeps closer to his prey.

videos.title: All Hope Abandon
videos.overview: The amulet's signal leads DARKCOM to a run-down apartment building. But is it really the Rabbit's lair... or a trap? Dante learns his true origins.

videos.title: Descent
videos.overview: Grim discoveries complicate Mary's mission. An exhilarating free fall fuels an epic transformation, forcing Dante to confront his demon side.

videos.title: The First Circle
videos.overview: A revealing trip down the rabbit hole yields a haunting tale of two childhoods — parallel stories with intertwining fates.

videos.title: At the Gates of Paradise
videos.overview: The stage is set for the ultimate showdown as the Rabbit and his army lie in wait for Dante to arrive. But there's more than one hero ready to fight.

videos.title: A River of Blood and Fire
videos.overview: Dante and Mary face impossible choices — and an enemy more powerful than the world has ever seen. In the aftermath, Baines puts a bold plan into motion.

videos.title: The Fallen
videos.overview: With Dante in a deep freeze, war erupts in the demon world. Lady combs Mundus' lair for an ancient weapon. An invitation reaches Vergil from Earth.

videos.title: Shades
videos.overview: Arius sends Dante into action with a plan to pit twin against twin. But Dante's thaw from his cold cryo-nightmare stirs dark and troubling visions.

videos.title: The Panther, the Lion, the Wolf
videos.overview: As Dante and Vergil hurtle toward a fateful clash in the present, memories from the past uncover old wounds — and the family tragedy that tore them apart.

videos.title: A Pit of Serpents
videos.overview: As Vergil battles a foe bent on bringing back chaos, a wounded Dante asks for Lady's help. A bold plan comes together on the eve of a rare eclipse.

videos.title: The Garden of Deadly Sins
videos.overview: Dante and Lady visit a professor with mysterious powers to keep Arius away from the Arcana — and prevent the return of Argosax himself.

videos.title: Purgatorio
videos.overview: A flashback sheds light on Baines' and Lady's first meeting. With Vergil in another dimension, Dante's forced to see things from a different perspective.

videos.title: Into the City of Woe
videos.overview: Chaos reigns on Earth in the wake of a fiery resurrection as an oracle shows Vergil the truth. To save the world, Dante and Lady must divide and conquer.

videos.title: Vexilla Regis Prodeunt Inferni
videos.overview: Siblings choose sides as a rift ripped open between realms ushers in the ultimate showdown where vengeance, power, fate and loyalty collide.
